recommendation: Keep the fix. A full publisher run should regenerate fhir.schema.shex.zip as a multi-entry ZIP of raw granular ShEx artifacts; if kindling later changes where ShEx artifacts are emitted, update the publishDir scan rather than reverting to single-file packaging.
issue_request: FHIR-25621 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for R5 asking that fhir.schema.shex.zip include all ShEx files, not just fhir.shex, so consumers can use granular ShEx artifacts such as resource- or datatype-specific schemas.
initial_application: No git history entry mentioning FHIR-25621 or 25621 was found. The older FHIR-20561/GF#20561 history fixed the existence/linkage of fhir.schema.shex.zip, but current build.fhir.org still serves fhir.schema.shex.zip with a single fhir.shex entry, so the all-artifacts request was not fully applied.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2020-01-27 corroborate the Jira vote as Persuasive, Grahame/Eric 9-0-0. The current build separately exposes granular ShEx content, including raw resource ShEx such as patient.shex and generated ShEx HTML pages such as integer.shex with an embedded ShEx pre block. README.md and publish.sh document ./gradlew publish as the current build entry point, making build.gradle.kts the in-scope source location for this packaging behavior.
reconciliation: Changed build.gradle.kts so publish and publishFull call a ShEx ZIP refresh after the publisher succeeds. The helper scans publish/ for .shex and .shex.html artifacts, extracts raw ShEx text from generated HTML pages when needed, prefers raw .shex files over duplicate HTML renderings, writes publish/fhir.schema.shex.zip, and fails explicitly if no generated ShEx artifacts are available. A packageShexSchemas task was added for direct validation or recovery use.
source_changes: build.gradle.kts: Added ShEx artifact collection and raw extraction helpers, a packageShexSchemas task, and publish/publishFull post-processing to refresh publish/fhir.schema.shex.zip.
